name: Maison Ghost
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Maison Ghost’s Discord was hacked, the hacker posted a fake minting link, and within minutes about 300 NFTs were stolen, including the Sandbox and 3landers NFTs, which were then sold for 128 ETH and eventually sent to Tornado.
